POP series

POP Series 8

Released September 1, 2008 · 17 cards

POP Series 8 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the POP series, released in English on September 1, 2008. It has 17 cards. It includes 14 Pokémon, 3 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

9 illustrators worked on POP Series 8. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (4), Atsuko Nishida (2), Kagemaru Himeno (2), Kouki Saitou (2), Masakazu Fukuda (2), Ryo Ueda (2), Kanako Eo (1), Kent Kanetsuna (1).
